title: Asiad: PH’s Alvarez bags bronze in men’s traditional -77kg MMA
summary: Carlos Alvarez concluded his campaign in the men’s traditional -77kg mixed martial arts competition at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on a high note by securing a bronze medal for the Philippines.
